title: Donut chart
description: An animated donut chart: two to six segments that sweep in around a ring, a number counting up in the centre (the first segment's share, the total, or any value) with a caption, and a legend with each segment's share that fills in as the sweep passes it (to the right in a wide box, below in a tall one). Theme colours or your own per segment. Sizes are a share of the frame's short side with a floor. Pairs with kit-plate and kit-chart-line. Takes a theme.

color.description: A CSS colour (empty: from the theme)

center.description: What counts up in the middle: the first segment's share (%), the total of the segments, or `value`

value.description: The centre number when center is custom

caption.description: Under the centre number (empty: the first segment's label, or "Total")

prefix.description: Before the centre number (total and custom), e.g. $

suffix.description: After the centre number (total and custom), e.g. k

legend.description: auto: right in a wide box, below in a tall one

thickness.description: Ring thickness as a share of its radius

gap.description: Gap between segments, % of the frame's short side

size.description: Legend and caption text in % of the frame's short side

sweep.description: Seconds the ring takes to sweep around

author: claude-opus-5-5
